items.title: Noah Cook Interview, 1960-08-30
items.q: I was a Wistler master of a large here for eight years.

ctx.x: And I don't have to ask for it. I don't have to ask for it. I've been presiding off the society for the last 25 years. And I don't have to ask for it. They give it to me. Just pick me out. In the election, they pick me out and give it to me. I just go ahead and marvel one-sided way and do it. Our Chaska man had been alive four years. I was a Wistler master of a large here for eight years. And I've been off since the society ever since I've been here. The first society I joined, it broke up. Then I joined the…
Well, what society was the first one you joined here?
